user.title: Family Task Card Integration
user.description: Adds a points ledger for the Family Task Card. Nothing to set up: people appear with their first booking.

not_loaded.message: The Family Task Card Integration is not set up yet.

offer_self.message: A chore can't be handed to the same person.

offer_taken.message: This chore was already taken over this round.

award.name: Award points
award.description: Books points for a checked-off task. A key that was already booked is ignored, so several devices can report the same task.

key.name: Key
key.description: Unique key of this task completion.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who did it (person entity or name).

revoke.name: Revoke points
revoke.description: Takes the points of an awarded task back, e.g. when it was unchecked.

key.name: Key
key.description: Key the task was awarded with.

redeem.name: Redeem points
redeem.description: Spends points on a reward. Fails when the person has too few points.

adjust.name: Adjust points
adjust.description: Gives a bonus (positive) or a deduction (negative).

request_reward.name: Request a reward
request_reward.description: A child asks for a reward: its points are reserved and the parents get a push with “approve” / “deny”. Fails when there are too few points.

approve.name: Approve a reward
approve.description: Says yes to a reward request: the reserved points are spent.

deny.name: Deny a reward
deny.description: Says no to a reward request: the reserved points are free again.

offer_chore.name: Offer a chore
offer_chore.description: Hands a chore of this round to someone else, maybe for points. The points are reserved until the other person answers; the offer ends with the round.

key.name: Key
key.description: The chore in this round, as the card books it.

points.name: Points
points.description: What the sender pays for it; 0 is a favour.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: Name of the chore, for the history.

until.name: Until
until.description: Last day of the round; the offer ends after it. Default: today.

answer_offer.name: Answer a chore offer
answer_offer.description: Takes the chore over (the points move across) or turns it down. The sender can withdraw an open offer the same way.

accept.name: Accept
accept.description: Yes takes the chore over; no turns it down or withdraws it.

cover.name: Cover for someone
cover.description: Notes that a person did a chore for someone who was away; that person owes one back. Noted once per key.

key.name: Key
key.description: The chore done for them, as the card books it.

absent.name: Away
absent.description: Who was away and owes one back.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: Name of the chore, for the history.

even_out.name: Even it out
even_out.description: A person did a chore in return for someone who covered for them: settles their oldest open cover. Counted once per key.

key.name: Key
key.description: The chore done in return, as the card books it.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who was away and now did one in return.

init.title: Reward approval
init.description: Who gets a push to approve or deny a reward request? Pick the notify services of the parents' phones (Home Assistant Companion app).
